stops.title: Where Paul probably wrote
stops.text: Paul is thought to have written from Corinth: Phoebe comes from nearby Cenchreae, and Gaius (Paul's host) and Erastus (the city treasurer) send greetings.

stops.title: The collection for the poor
stops.text: Paul is about to take a gift from Macedonia and Achaia to the poor among believers in Jerusalem.

stops.title: The church in Rome
stops.text: Paul has not been to Rome, but hopes to visit and be sent on by them to Spain.
